subject: Clarify seat-credit conversion and tier bundling for Performance pilot
messages:
From: Joseph Alvarez <joseph@clearsight.health>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Packaging options for moving from Starter -> Performance

Hi Marissa,

We're evaluating moving our agents from the Starter plan to Performance to get lower latency and the reserved throughput for our inference jobs. Two quick asks: 1) how do unused seat commitments convert if we move mid-quarter (do we get credits or pro-rated refunds?), and 2) can we keep the private VPC add-on while swapping tiers, or does that require a separate order?

We're also trying to size the pilot for a month: want to run ~200k tokens/day peak with a 2k concurrent request burst for short periods. Can you point me to the packaging options and a rough delta in monthly spend? Procurement will want the numbers to assess.

Thanks — Joe
Joseph Alvarez
Head of Platform Engineering
ClearSight Health
joseph@clearsight.health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Joseph Alvarez <joseph@clearsight.health>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging options for moving from Starter -> Performance

Hi Joe — thanks for the details. Short answers up front: we can issue a one-time conversion credit for unused Starter seat commitments (typical is a pro-rated credit applied to the first invoice on Performance), and you can retain the Private/VPC add-on during a tier swap — it stays as an add-on line item, no separate onboarding is required.

I'll attach a short options summary — see the PDF. Two clarifying Qs so Ben and I can size this tighter:
- Do you have current committed seats or is Starter entirely metered for you?
- What's the cadence of your high-concurrency bursts (minutes, hours, once per week?)

Ben, can you weigh in on the credit math and a recommended pilot bundle (reserved throughput + burst buffer) that fits 200k tokens/day and the 2k burst?

Attached: ClearSight_Migration_Options.pdf (3 pages) — high-level costs and a sample SOW.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Joseph Alvarez <joseph@clearsight.health>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging options for moving from Starter -> Performance

Hi Joe — looping in with the numbers. Based on the usage you shared, here are three practical options (ballpark monthly costs and what the conversion looks like):

Option A — Performance Pilot (recommended)
- Reserved throughput: 100k tokens/day commit (cover baseline)
- Burst buffer: 2k concurrent reserved for 2 hours/day via burst credits
- One-time conversion credit: we apply a pro-rated credit equal to remaining Starter committed seat value (if Starter was metered, convert 50% of the last invoice as credit)
Estimated monthly delta vs Starter: +~$6k–8k (depending on model family).

Option B — Elastic Performance (lower commit)
- Metered baseline with on-demand reserved burst credits
- No one-time seat conversion credit (applies only if you have committed Starter seats)
Estimated monthly delta: +~$3k–5k.

Option C — Dedicated Pilot (short-term Dedicated pool)
- 2-week Dedicated pilot (fixed price) to validate latency and KV cache behavior
- Best for throughput-heavy tests, higher fixed cost but predictable
Estimated cost: one-time ~$25k for the pilot window.

Notes:
- Private/VPC is unchanged as an add-on; we keep it on your account.
- If procurement needs net-30 or an approved PO, we can accept that; discounts require approval from sales leadership.

I'll draft a short SOW for Option A and include the exact credit calc once Marissa confirms whether Starter had any committed seats.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: Joseph Alvarez <joseph@clearsight.health>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@clearsight.health, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 14:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Packaging options for moving from Starter -> Performance

Thanks Marissa/Ben — helpful. A couple clarifications:
- Starter is partly committed (we have a quarterly seat commitment that covers ~40% of our current usage).
- Bursts are typically 10–30 minutes, a few times per day during business hours.
- Procurement will ask for a 10% vendor discount on top of the pilot pricing and needs net-30 payment terms.

We're inclined to run the Performance Pilot (Option A) for 30 days to validate the burst behavior. Can you provide the expected monthly invoice delta and the credit number applied to the first invoice? Also want explicit language that VPC remains active during the swap and that log retention settings won't change.

Joe
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Joseph Alvarez <joseph@clearsight.health>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging options for moving from Starter -> Performance

Joe — attached is a concise proposal with three options and exact numbers tailored to ClearSight's current usage (see Performance_Pilot_SOW.docx). Summary here:

- Recommended: Option A (30-day Performance Pilot)
  • Monthly delta: $7,100 (estimate, model family TBD)
  • One-time conversion credit: $3,400 applied to first invoice (pro-rated remaining Starter committed seat value)
  • VPC add-on: unchanged; logs and retention settings will be preserved during the swap (we'll include this clause in the SOW)
  • Payment terms: we can accept net-30 once procurement sends a PO; a 10% discount requires sales leadership approval — I'll run it by our director and aim to respond by EOD tomorrow.

Next steps:
1) I'll send a formal SOW (attached) that includes the credit calc and the VPC/loging clause.
2) If procurement confirms net-30, send PO to billing@redwood.ai and we'll proceed with pilot onboarding.
3) Ben will provision a small Dedicated buffer for the first 48 hours of the pilot to stress-test latency if you want.

Link to deal: https://hubspot.company.com/deals/CSH-2026-071 — I'll update with the SOW when signed.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Joseph Alvarez <joseph@clearsight.health>

Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 16:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Packaging options for moving from Starter -> Performance

Marissa — this looks good. Procurement will route a PO for net-30 today. We'll accept Option A for the 30-day pilot; please include the VPC/log retention clause and the $3,400 conversion credit in the SOW. Also please attach a redline-friendly contract — our legal team will want to swap a couple of small clauses (data residency and indemnity cap).

Ben — please confirm the 48-hour Dedicated buffer provisioning and whether we'll need any additional credentials to run the stress tests.

I'll expect the SOW and contract redline before EOD Thursday.

Thanks — Joe
